config.label: Your QuickCloud API key (create one in the panel under API)
config.description: Your QuickCloud API key (create one in the panel under API). A read-only or product-limited key is the safest to give an assistant.

config.label: Panel origin
config.description: Panel origin. Only needed if your provider runs QuickCloud on their own domain (default https://cloud.quickhost.uk).

config.description: Set to 1 to allow the assistant to create and change things (equivalent to the --allow-write flag). Every write still asks for your confirmation.
